decisions.current_model: When an inserted/subordinate/participial construction after the subject requires a closing comma and the main subject-predicate structure independently requires a dash, both marks retain their own syntactic functions.
decisions.learner_policy: Do not teach comma+dash as a decorative indivisible sign.

current_no_dash_defaults: personal or demonstrative pronoun subject without special emphasis
intervening introductory/adverbial/object/particle component in neutral structure
adjectival predicate where no independent dash condition applies
decisions.variation_note: Current academic rules explicitly allow a dash with pronoun subjects or other default no-dash patterns under contrast, emphatic stress or structural/intonic motivation.
decisions.patch_policy: Keep the source table as defaults, never as a list of absolute prohibitions.

current_patterns: O, а именно: o, o, o
o, o, o — одним словом, O
o, o, o — короче говоря, O
decisions.patch_policy: Keep separate from broader clarification/apposition rules; identify the syntactic pattern first.

decisions.current_high_value_boundary: At the start of a sentence/clause linkage ОДНАКО is normally conjunctional, not automatically followed by a comma; a following comma there may belong to an inserted construction or interjectional use.

current_functions: conjunction linking clauses, including если... значит / раз... значит
copular/linking ЗНАЧИТ in infinitival predicate structure
decisions.patch_policy: Expand learner metadata to the explicit four-function model; no new identity.

current_model.introductory: final link or summary in an explicit/implicit enumeration
current_model.adverbial: at last / after time or effort / in the end

decisions.diagnostic_note: -то is a useful signal of the adverbial meaning but not a substitute for contextual analysis.

current_functions: introductory when equivalent to вообще говоря
adverb in meanings such as о людях вообще
particle/intensifier in contexts such as он вообще не приехал
decisions.patch_policy: Keep the corrected contextual unit; this is precisely why the old blanket source rule must remain rejected.
